name: AG Anadolu Grubu Holding A.S.
summary: AG Anadolu Grubu Holding A.S., together with its subsidiaries, operates in the retail market in Turkey and internationally. The company operates through Beer, Soft Drinks, Migros, Automotive, Agriculture, Energy, Industry, and Other segments. It is involved in the production, bottling, distribution, and sales of beer, carbonated, and non-carbonated beverages; sales of food, beverage, and durable goods; distribution and sale of Coca-Cola products; production and sales of Isuzu branded commercial vehicles; wholesale and retail sale of electricity and its capacity; and production and transmission of electricity, and establishment and operation of distribution facilities, as well as IT, internet…
